name: mantle
description: Build and embed Mantle applications. Cold start: npx skills add aotter/mantle.

interface.longDescription: Cold start with npx skills add aotter/mantle. Follow that skill to the pinned CLI and handbook, then compose only the modules the host needs.
defaultPrompt: Run npx skills add aotter/mantle, then follow the installed mantle skill
Follow the Mantle skill: interview for host and surfaces before writing files
Author a Mantle application from the Mantle skill and an official example
